# Elyssa dev board (Moovma)

> Elyssa is "the first Tunisian dev board": ESP32-S3FN8, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth LE 5, native USB-C, RGB LED, 6-axis IMU, microSD, LiPo charger. This file lists the best sources for answering questions about it. Read AGENTS.md first.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): verified facts, pin map, power rules, quick answers (analog pins, battery divider VBAT/2, 3.3 V logic)
- [README.md](README.md): quick start, pinout, features, troubleshooting
- [TIPS_AND_KNOWN_ISSUES.md](TIPS_AND_KNOWN_ISSUES.md): IMU, LED, Wi-Fi, pin and build notes
- [platform/variants/elyssa/pins_arduino.h](platform/variants/elyssa/pins_arduino.h): official pin definitions
- [Website docs](https://moovma-git-main-moovma.vercel.app/docs): pin safety and power rules
